question:
A cylindrical region of radius $R$ contains a uniform magnetic field perpendicular to the plane, varying as $B(t)=kt$ for $t\ge 0$. A particle of mass $m$ and charge $q$ is initially at rest at a distance $r$ from the axis, with $r< R$. For a very short time interval $\Delta t$, neglect the magnetic force on the particle due to its motion (i.e., treat the motion as driven only by the induced electric field).

To leading order in $\Delta t$, find the kinetic energy gained by the particle in time $\Delta t$.
